subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add user OAuth or Workspace event-subscription support so Space messages can be received without @mentions, and what credential/config contract should own that capability?
rationale: The remaining work changes Google Chat credential storage, user consent scopes, event delivery semantics, and fallback behavior; source inspection proves the gap, but automation cannot choose the permanent security and product boundary.

options.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
options.body: Implement a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or event-subscription model for all-message Space ingestion while preserving service-account webhook verification and bot-level sends.

options.title: Keep mention-gated service-account behavior
options.body: Document non-mention Space ingestion as unsupported for now and continue requiring @mentions under the service-account app webhook model.

options.title: Split the work before implementation
options.body: Track thread-session cleanup through the open thread PR and create a narrower maintainer-owned issue for all-message Space ingestion auth design.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
recommendation.body: Implement a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or event-subscription model for all-message Space ingestion while preserving service-account webhook verification and bot-level sends.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current combination of Google Chat source history and prior maintainer-side review context for this auth/config boundary.
